procedure: Bind candidate content to current source versions.
Establish original provenance, access, periods and availability.
Quarantine unknown timing and exclude post-cutoff support.
Return source eligibility, dependencies, conflicts and targeted inquiries.

acceptance.expectation: Source/version locations, measured hashes or access reasons, covered periods, availability evidence, retrieval times and cutoff dispositions are recorded separately.
Unknown-timing and post-cutoff records are present in the quarantine register and are not marked eligible as-of support.
Assessment distinguishes original observations, dependent retellings, issuer assertions, conflicting versions and unavailable evidence without approving assumption plausibility.

conditions: Required source or execution tool unavailable
Acceptance test fails or remains unperformed
failure.record: failure_records; identify affected record, evidence/test, consequence, next action and conclusion restriction
